---
title: as-numeric
subtitle: Coerce a column to numeric, or tag an aesthetic as continuous.
category: Core
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Two call forms:
when given `(data, col)` it returns a new dataset with `col` parsed as a
number in every row; when given `(col)` alone it returns a mapping-ref
annotation that [`aes`](aes.qmd) accepts in place of a column name, forcing the scale
system to treat that channel as continuous.

## Usage

```typst
as-numeric(data, col)
```

```typst
as-numeric(col)
```

## Arities

- `as-numeric(data, col)`: Return a new dataset with `col` converted to numbers via `parse-number`.
- `as-numeric(col)`: Return a `mapping-ref` dict tagging `col` as continuous for [`aes`](aes.qmd).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `..args` |  | Either `(data, col)` or `(col)`. See arities. |

## Returns

New dataset (2-arg) or mapping-ref dict (1-arg).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/as-numeric-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let raw = (
  (x: "1", y: 2.0),
  (x: "2", y: 4.0),
  (x: "3", y: 9.0),
)
#let d = as-numeric(raw, "x")
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt),),
)
```
